 Instagram, email, web chat) via Intercom. Build and optimize automated
 



 workﬂows for:
 



 i) Lead nurturing
 



 ii) Trial follow\-ups
 



 iii) Retention and win\-back campaigns
 



  





 b) Milestones, birthdays, and engagement triggers
 



  





 c) Ensure all communication is behaviour\-triggered and data\-driven
 



  





 d) Oversee AI agent performance, lead qualiﬁcation, and handoff to sales
 



 teams
 



  





**3\) Feedback, NPS \& Helpdesk Systems** 




 a) Implement and manage post\-class feedback and NPS systems.
 



 b) Ensure feedback is linked directly to client proﬁles for actionable insights.
 



 c) Build and manage the helpdesk/ticketing system with SLA tracking and
 



 escalation workﬂows.
 



 d) Enable real\-time alerts for negative feedback and critical issues.
 



 e) Track resolution metrics and continuously improve service response quality
 



  





**4\) Momence Integration Ownership** 




 a) Own the deep API integration between Momence and internal systems.
 



 b) Ensure real\-time, bi\-directional sync of:
 



 i) Bookings
 



 ii) Attendance
 



 iii) Purchases
 



 iv) Client data
 



 c) Design and implement event\-based triggers from Momence data:
 



 i) Missed class → follow\-up workﬂows

 iii) Purchases → onboarding and upsell journeys
 



 d) Eliminate manual data handling and ensure full system automations.

 systems
 



  





**5\) Analytics, Reporting \& Insights** 




 a) Build and manage dashboards for:
 



 i) Retention and churn
 



 ii) Revenue (per client, class, instructor)
 



 iii) Marketing attribution
 



  





 b) Implement automated daily and monthly reporting with AI\-driven insights.
 



  





 c) Ensure a uniﬁed reporting layer across sales, operations, and ﬁnance.
 



  





 d) Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities to improve performance
 



  





**6\) AI \& Personalisation Systems** 




 a) Implement AI\-driven features including:
 



 i) Class 0recommendations
 



 ii) Churn prediction models
 



 iii) Dynamic pricing strategies
 



  





 b) Enable personalised communication and content based on client behaviour.
 



  





 c) Continuously improve AI models based on data and outcomes
 



  





**7\) Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 




 a) Work closely with Sales, Operations, and CST teams to ensure system
 



 adoption and effectiveness.

 c) Drive training, SOPs, and best practices for system usage.

 ● Strong understanding of CRM systems, automation tools, and integrations
 



 ● Experience working with APIs, system integrations, or no\-code/low\-code platforms

 development skills (e.g., familiarity with JavaScript, Python, SQL, or modern web
 



 frameworks).

title: Senior BIM Modeler - Mechanical
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
   

  

 We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
   

  

**Role description:**
 We are now recruiting talented individuals to fill our current vacancy for BIM Modeler II to work on our projects in Bangalore/Noida/Hyderabad. To be considered for a role we are seeking candidates with the following credentials:
   

  

**Role accountabilities:**
* Managing the production and verification of BIM models and drawings for selected projects (or components of projects) for Water team.
* Taking responsibility for technical quality assurance and client feedback and ensuring effective communication of any changes/ modifications.
* Proactively engaging with various Arcadis Regional offices/ teams regarding safe design requirements, and flag risks at appropriate levels.
* Resolving issues and create strong relationships with project colleagues in the regions, evidenced through great feedback.
* Reviewing work and drive the culture of checking and accountability in the team, including interdisciplinary checks
* Liaising with and assisting the design professional and BIM Manager
* Adhere to the schedule and quality requirements.
* Working in collaboration with other design disciplines to ensure the integrity of the overall design.
* Collaborate and coordinate with other disciplines to mitigate design challenges.
* Design Health \& Safety management for the project works.
* Develop BIM Execution Plan and BIM project workflow criteria.
* Follow BIM content standards and development procedures.
* Prepare own discipline model and/or content for BIM Coordination Meetings.
* High level of communication and good writing skills.
* Leveraging BIM software and tools as a methodology to coordinate design documentation.
* Follow BIM content standards and development procedures.
* May take the lead on developing some discipline specific BIM modeling content for project.
* Prepare own discipline model and/or content for BIM Coordination Meetings.


**Software Expectations:**
* Good Knowledge of REVIT® and Plant 3D (P\&ID)
* Knowledge of BIM tools such as Autodesk Civil 3D, Navisworks Manage, BIM 360, etc.
* AutoCAD – for drawing linkage and cleanup. MicroStation knowledge will be an added advantage.
* General understanding of interoperability between software used to accomplish own discipline tasks.
* Demonstrated delivery acumen. Experience in mechanical drawings and BIM models for medium to large scale projects related to,
+ Treatment plants,
+ Pumping stations and other related structures,
+ Water and wastewater conveyance systems,
+ P\&IDs, and routing pipe as per P\&ID,
+ Storage tanks and pump station pipework,
+ Design and development of Equipment and Piping layouts,
+ Drainage systems,
+ Flood protection facilities.

* Experience of delivering mechanical drawings and BIM models at all stages from concept through to final project and construction delivery.
* Knowledge/ experience in UK/ European water industry is preferable.
* Produce 2D drawings for new or improved products using industry, departmental and discipline standards.
* Preparation of design input to Design Team and co\-ordinate with other staff to prepare drawings.
* Liaison with other team members to produce good design solution as per best design practice.
* Keeping up\-to\-date with innovations and developments.
* Performing other duties and responsibilities as required from time to time.


**Required competencies:**
* Sound technical knowledge, academically good.
* Familiar with British codes, drawing standards and practices related to Mechanical/ water utility modelling and drawing production.
* Awareness of software used for BIM modelling.
* Good knowledge of Revit, Plant 3D, BIM 360 etc.
* Good knowledge of Microsoft office.
* A strong, self\-motivated and assertive person capable of working under pressure.
* Well\-developed interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively at all levels.
* Flexible to adopt new work /challenge work as per business requirement.
* Compliance of Arcadis business management system.
* Health \& Safety Management
* Performing other duties and responsibilities as required from time to time.
* This role provides Design or redesign complex models and drawings from general written or verbal specifications from Group Leader.
* Produce CAD drawings for new or improved products using industry, departmental and discipline standards.
* Preparation of design input to Design Team and co\-ordinate with other staff to prepare drawings.
* Liaison with other team members to produce good design solution as per best design practice.


**Qualifications \& Experience:**
* Degree in Mechanical Engineering/BE Mechanical / from recognized University.
* 7\-9 years’ experience as BIM Modeler.


 Why Arcadis?
   

  

 We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills\-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
   

  

 You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
   

  

 Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
   

  

 Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
   

  

 Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion \& Belonging
   

  

 We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day which is why equality and inclusion is at the forefront of all our activities. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. We are an equal opportunity employer; women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. We are dedicated to a policy of non\-discrimination in employment on any basis including race, caste, creed, colour, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, and gender identity.

title: Freelance Environmental Auditor / Verifier
description:
We are seeking highly experienced Freelance Environmental Auditors / Verifiers to support audit and verification assignments across India, Sri Lanka, and Nepal. This project\-based engagement is intended for seasoned environmental compliance professionals with substantial industry and audit experience who can work independently, travel to client and supplier sites, exercise sound professional judgement, and deliver clear, accurate, evidence\-based, and defensible audit reports within agreed timelines. Assignments will cover a range of manufacturing sectors, with a strong preference for candidates experienced in the leather accessories manufacturing sector and tannery processes.
 


  

 Tasks
   

  
* Plan and conduct on\-site environmental audits and verifications at manufacturing facilities, in line with recognized standards and client\-specific protocols.
  
* Assess compliance with environmental regulations, permits, and international standards (e.g., ISO 14001, ZDHC, Higg FEM, and similar frameworks as applicable).
  
* Evaluate site\-level environmental aspects including effluent treatment (ETP/STP), air emissions, hazardous waste and chemical management, water usage, and energy management.
  
* Identify non\-conformances, conduct root cause analysis, and verify corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  
* Analyse and articulate audit findings, supporting evidence, risks, root causes, and required corrective actions in clear, concise, accurate, and defensible audit/verification reports, submitted in the required format and within agreed timelines.
  
* Liaise professionally with facility management, client representatives, and internal reviewers throughout the audit lifecycle.
  
* Maintain audit records and documentation in accordance with confidentiality and data protection requirements.
  
* Travel to audit locations across India, Sri Lanka, and Nepal as assignments require.
  


  

 Requirements
   

  
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field.
  
* A minimum of 10 years' relevant industry experience in environmental management, EHS, sustainability, manufacturing operations, environmental compliance, or a related field.
  
* At least 5 years' hands\-on experience conducting environmental audits, assessments, or verification assignments, including site inspections, evidence review, identification of non\-conformances, and CAPA verification.
  
* Experience auditing the leather accessories manufacturing sector and/or tannery processes is strongly preferred.
  
* Familiarity with relevant certification and verification schemes, including ISO 14001, ZDHC, Higg FEM/FDM, LWG, or comparable frameworks, is an advantage.
  
* Sound technical knowledge of environmental aspects including effluent treatment, air emissions, chemical management, hazardous waste, water use, energy management, and applicable air and water compliance requirements.
  
* Demonstrated ability to analyse complex information and articulate audit findings, conclusions, risks, and recommendations in clear, structured, evidence\-based, and professionally written English reports.
  
* Strong analytical, interviewing, communication, stakeholder\-management, and professional judgement skills.
  
* Willingness and ability to travel across India, Sri Lanka, and Nepal for on\-site assignments; ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and meet agreed reporting deadlines. Relevant lead auditor certification(s) preferred.
 **Professional Independence and Conflict of Interest:** 
 The auditor/verifier must remain independent, objective, and impartial in the performance of all assignments and must not have any financial, commercial, employment, advisory, familial, or other relationship that could create an actual, potential, or perceived conflict of interest.
  
* Any actual, potential, or perceived conflict of interest must be disclosed in writing before accepting an assignment and promptly if it arises during an assignment.
  
* The auditor/verifier must not accept or continue any assignment where their independence, objectivity, or professional judgement may reasonably be compromised, unless the conflict has been reviewed and expressly cleared in writing by the engaging organisation.
  
* All information obtained during an assignment must be treated as confidential and used solely for the authorised audit or verification purpose.
  


  

 Benefits
   


 As per industry standard

title: Business Intelligence Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Insights \& Analytics Lead (Business Intelligence) for a Series A funded Wellness Brand.
 



  





**Job Profile** 




 Your work will typically move through: Business Question \> Data \> Analysis \> Insight \> Decision \> Outcome.
 



 Knowing the difference between Fact, Inference, Hypothesis, and Unknown will be an important part of the job.
 



 Solve ambiguous business problems.\*\* Take loosely defined questions and structure them into analytical problems that can actually be investigated.
 



 Diagnose performance. Identify the underlying drivers behind important business movements rather than simply reporting the movement.
 



 Generate insights. Find patterns, relationships, exceptions, and opportunities that are not obvious from standard reporting.
 



 Challenge assumptions. Test prevailing explanations rather than accepting the first plausible narrative, including your own.
 



 Create a common fact base. Help leadership distinguish between what we know, what we believe, and what we still need to find out.
 



 Translate analysis into business language. Turn complex analysis into concise conclusions that senior leaders can understand and act upon.
 



 Support important decisions. As you build context and credibility, increasingly contribute to recommendations, experiments, and decision\-making.
 



 Build analytical systems. Develop reusable frameworks and diagnostic approaches so the organisation becomes progressively less dependent on individual intuition.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 Any Post Graduate
 



 5\-10 Years of experience
 



 Must have proven experience solving unusually difficult analytical problems
 



 You could come from Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Strategy, Consulting, Business Intelligence, Growth, Product, Marketing Analytics, Operations, Revenue Management, Corporate Strategy, Finance, Founder or Chief of Staff roles, or other analytically intensive functions.
 



 You could have worked in Consumer, Technology, SaaS, E\-commerce, Q\-commerce, Fintech, Edtech, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, Consulting, or something completely different.
 



 Industry experience is not a prerequisite. If you are a strong analytical thinker, we expect you to learn a new business.
 



 What we need:
 



 Analytical reasoning\- You can take a messy problem, break it down, and determine what needs to be understood.
 



 Data fluency\- You are comfortable working directly with data and can independently investigate a problem using tools such as Excel/Sheets, SQL, BI tools, or equivalent. You do not need to be a data engineer. You do need to be able to go behind a dashboard when the question requires it.
 



 Business judgment\- You understand that analysis is valuable only when it improves understanding or decisions. You naturally ask: “So what?”
 



 Intellectual independence\- You are willing to challenge an attractive explanation when the evidence does not support it.
 



 Intellectual honesty\- You are comfortable saying “I don’t know yet” and equally comfortable saying “I was wrong.”
 



 Communication\- You can take something complicated and explain it simply.
 



 What This Role Is NOT
 



 This is not primarily a MIS role, reporting role, dashboard\-building role, Tableau administration role, data engineering role, or data\-entry role. We are not looking for someone whose main contribution is producing more reports.
 



 You should be comfortable with analytical tools such as Excel/Google Sheets, SQL or equivalent, and Tableau/Power BI/Looker or similar BI platforms. Python, statistics, and experimentation capabilities are useful additions.

title: Business Manager (Growth Track) – Atleisure by Roology
description:
**Location:** 
 Mumbai (Andheri West)
 **Employment type:** 
 Full\-time
 **Reports to:** 
 Founder
 **Team:** 
 1 intern will report to this role
 **Start date:** 
 October 1, 2026
 **Compensation:** 
 ₹25,000/month for the first 3 months, reviewed alongside the promotion decision below
 


 About Atleisure
 
 Atleisure by Roology is the newest label from Roology, a Mumbai\-based D2C womenswear brand. Atleisure is built around ease, not hustle — elevated comfort wear for women who are done performing productivity 24/7\. We're early\-stage, fast\-moving, and building the brand and the business at the same time — which means this role won't look like a "job description" for very long. It'll evolve as fast as you do.
 


 About the role
 
 We're hiring a generalist who wants to grow into a true Business Manager role — someone who can sit across operations, marketing, and finance in these early months, acting as the connective tissue between the founder, our vendors, our PR/social team, and everyone else keeping Atleisure running day to day. You'll also have an intern working under you from day one — so alongside learning the business, you'll be getting your first experience directing someone else's work.
 



 This is deliberately a
 **growth\-track role** 
 : you'll start hands\-on across all three functions, learning the business from the inside out. Based on performance, you'll be formally reviewed for promotion to
 **Business Manager within 3 months** 
 — with a compensation review at the same time — taking on greater ownership and ambiguity as you prove you can run with it.
 



 If you're early in your career and the idea of learning ops, marketing, and finance simultaneously at a founder's side — rather than being boxed into one narrow function — genuinely excites you, this is built for you.
 


 What you'll do
 
**Operations** 



* Coordinate day\-to\-day operations — vendor follow\-ups, order fulfillment tracking, inventory coordination
* Handle customer queries and support — order status, pre\- and post\-sales questions, and escalations
* Direct and check in on the intern's work, making sure their output actually moves things forward
* Act as the point of contact between the founder and external teams (PR, vendors, freelancers), making sure nothing falls through the cracks
* Document processes as you learn them, so the business runs on systems, not on memory



**Marketing** 



* Own the weekly content/posting calendar in coordination with our social/PR team, keeping Instagram active and on\-schedule
* Track campaign and content performance, flag what's working and what isn't
* Support influencer and PR outreach coordination



**Finance** 



* Track expenses, vendor payments, and basic budget\-vs\-actuals
* Support the founder in monthly financial reviews and reporting
* Flag discrepancies or gaps early, rather than after they've become a problem



**Mediator, across all of it** 



* Translate the founder's priorities into action across teams, and surface what each team needs back up to the founder
* Keep multiple moving parts (marketing, ops, finance, external vendors) talking to each other instead of operating in silos


 What we're looking for
 
**Skills** 



* Strong written and verbal communication — you'll be the go\-between for multiple people and functions, and customer\-facing at times
* Comfortable with spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) for tracking and reporting
* Organized, detail\-oriented, able to juggle several open threads without dropping any
* Basic familiarity with Instagram/social platforms and e\-commerce (Shopify) is a plus, not a requirement



**Attitude** 



* Genuinely seeks to learn — asks questions, follows up, doesn't wait to be told twice
* Comfortable with ambiguity and a startup pace where the job description shifts as the business does
* Takes ownership rather than waiting for instructions on everything, and comfortable owning an intern's output as well as your own
* Resilient — early\-stage brands have setbacks and false starts, and we need someone who treats that as normal, not alarming



**Knowledge / background** 



* No prior experience in a specific function (ops, marketing, or finance) is required — full training will be provided
* Any prior exposure to D2C/e\-commerce, retail, or a startup environment is a bonus, not a must
* Freshers and early\-career candidates (0–2 years) are welcome to apply


 Why join
 * Direct mentorship from the founder, with real exposure to how a D2C brand is actually built and run
* Early people\-management experience — you'll have an intern supporting you from day one
* A defined growth path — a formal shot at the Business Manager title (and a compensation review) within your first 3 months, not a vague "maybe someday"
* The chance to shape a young brand's systems from the ground up, rather than inheriting someone else's playbook
* Part of the Roology family — access to the learning, processes, and network of an already\-running sister brand


 How to apply
 
 Email us at arushi@atleisureculture.com

title: Creative Epicure
description:
**Creative Epicure** 




  





 Location: Andheri East. Mumbai
 



 Eight or more years of experience. On premise and remote.
 



  





  





**The role** 




  





 Ajmal Perfumes is looking for a Creative Epicure. The title is unusual because the job is unusual. This is not a role about making one beautiful film. It is a role about making sure that everything we release, at the volume and the speed that performance marketing now demands, still looks like us and still looks premium.
 



 Fragrance has become a video first category and the work is getting results. It has also converged, and a great deal of it is now difficult to tell apart. Ajmal is a premium house and intends to remain one, which means our work should be ours on sight. Building the system that makes that possible, and holding it steady while output scales, is the job.
 



  





**What you will own** 




  




* The video template system for the brand, built so that what has to stay constant stays constant and what should vary is free to vary.
* The way the brand sounds and reads on screen, authored in Hindi and in English rather than written in one and translated into the other.
* The craft standard across a portfolio that runs across several price points and several audiences.
* How we work with creators, and how their work is directed so that it carries us rather than absorbs us.
* The recurring craft decisions that make our films identifiable as ours.
* The argument for all of the above at the moments when the calendar pushes back against it.



**The core of the job** 




  





 These four are the reason the role exists. A good deal else is negotiable and these are not.
 


* You can build templates. You understand that volume and speed are hygiene in this category, and that neither is an acceptable reason for quality to fall.
* You can express brand personality and visual identity strongly enough that the work stands apart in a crowded category and is recognisable before the logo appears.
* You know that a rigid template chokes creativity and cannot carry a wide range of products, so you design flexibility into the system itself instead of granting exceptions around it.
* You work video first. You think in motion, in sound and in pacing rather than in layouts that get animated later.



  





**Who we are looking for** 




  




* Eight or more years across brand, advertising, content or production.
* An art first creative who also understands film and copy. We will consider a copy led creative just as seriously, provided the art and visual skill is strong and the video capability is real.
* A working command of film and video making. You understand framing, pacing, the edit, sound, and what is genuinely achievable inside a two day shoot.
* You love fragrance. You have opinions about scent and you can talk about a perfume without describing the bottle.
* Mastery level Hindi and English. Strength in another Indian regional language is a clear advantage.
* Mumbai based, or ready to be.



**How the role works** 




  





 The role is on premise and remote, and the balance between the two is something we will arrive at together. Parts of this job need a room, a shoot floor and an edit suite. Other parts need quiet and distance.
 



 You will report to \[reporting line to be confirmed]. Compensation is \[band to be confirmed] and we will discuss it openly and early.
 



  





**Why you might want this** 




  





 You will be handed a category that currently looks much the same everywhere, and you will be asked to make one brand inside it look like itself, at scale, without slowing anything down. If you have spent years watching good craft traded away for turnaround time, this is the role where you get to build the thing that stops it.
 



 We have said less here than we could. What you would actually build is a conversation rather than a public page, and we will be open about all of it once we are talking.

title: Manager - Ecommerce transformation
description:

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation will drive ecommerce transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining digital commerce strategy, customer experience improvement, operating model design, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in improving online growth, commerce operations, product discovery, conversion, order experience, and omnichannel effectiveness. You will work with business and technology stakeholders to shape commerce roadmaps, design scalable operating models, and implement transformation initiatives that improve revenue realization, digital adoption, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

+ Support ecommerce transformation pipeline development across advisory, implementation, and managed transformation opportunities.
+ Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, business cases, demos, and executive presentations focused on digital commerce growth and operational improvement.

* Client Engagement \& Delivery
+ Lead ecommerce transformation workstreams from current\-state assessment through strategy, roadmap design, implementation planning, and execution support.
+ Assess commerce journeys, digital storefronts, product information flows, merchandising processes, search and navigation, order management touchpoints, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
+ Design ecommerce operating models, governance structures, product data processes, merchandising workflows, channel strategies, and performance management frameworks.
+ Support initiatives across product discovery, catalog readiness, personalization, pricing and promotions, cart and checkout, order visibility, returns experience, and customer support integration.
+ Partner with product, technology, data, marketing, sales, and operations teams to translate commerce priorities into structured requirements, process flows, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
+ Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify conversion improvement, revenue uplift, digital adoption, cost\-to\-serve reduction, and operational productivity gains.
+ Ensure delivery excellence across assigned workstreams, including scope, timeline, budget, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment.
+ Support change management, adoption, and governance activities to embed sustainable commerce capabilities across business teams.


* Technology \& Innovation
+ Enable teams to leverage ecommerce platforms, product information management systems, order management systems, CRM, analytics, personalization tools, automation, and AI\-enabled insights.
+ Stay ahead of technology trends shaping ecommerce transformation, including composable commerce, headless architecture, AI\-enabled product discovery, personalization, digital shelf analytics, and omnichannel orchestration.
+ Identify opportunities to develop reusable accelerators for commerce journey assessment, product data maturity, conversion diagnostics, and benefits tracking.


* Leadership \& People Development
+ Manage project teams or workstreams and ensure high\-quality delivery across ecommerce transformation engagements.
+ Mentor consultants and analysts on ecommerce strategy, requirements structuring, delivery governance, and cross\-functional stakeholder management.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Demonstrate knowledge of digital commerce capabilities, including B2B and B2C commerce, marketplace models, dealer and distributor portals, and subscription commerce.
* Have exposure to leading commerce platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Shopify, SAP Commerce Cloud, commerce tools, BigCommerce, Akeneo, Salsify, and similar technologies.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years of experience in ecommerce transformation, digital commerce, omnichannel strategy, customer experience, product data transformation, or commerce operations.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading ecommerce transformation programs, digital channel improvement initiatives, or commerce operating model redesign.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce journeys, digital merchandising, product information management, order experience, conversion optimization, and commerce performance metrics.
* Hands\-on experience with ecommerce platforms, analytics tools, PIM, OMS, CRM, or related digital commerce technologies.
* Strong business development support, stakeholder management, communication, and project delivery skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

 Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:**

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.

description:

 Lead \- YT Operations
 



**Location:** 
 Mumbai / Kolkata
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



  





**About SVF** 




 SVF is Eastern India's largest media \& entertainment company, spanning film production and distribution, music, television, and cinema exhibition — alongside hoichoi, its OTT platform reaching roughly 250 million Bengalis worldwide. SVF's YouTube presence is one of the largest and most active Bengali media footprints on the platform, spanning film, music, and entertainment content watched by audiences across the world.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 SVF is looking for someone to take end\-to\-end ownership of its YouTube operations — how content gets scheduled, optimised, monetised, and protected across a high\-volume, multi\-channel portfolio. This is a role for someone who thinks natively in watch time, retention curves, and metadata, and who can turn a channel's raw content strength into consistent, compounding growth. You'll be the person who knows why a video underperformed before anyone else asks the question — and already has three fixes ready.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Own end\-to\-end YouTube operations across SVF's channel portfolio — upload scheduling, metadata, thumbnails, and publishing cadence.
* Lead channel growth strategy, using analytics to drive programming, format, and content\-mix decisions.
* Manage Content ID, copyright claims, and rights\-related issues across the channel portfolio.
* Optimise videos for discoverability — titles, descriptions, tags, thumbnails, and end screens.
* Track and report on channel performance (views, watch time, subscriber growth, RPM) and translate insights into action.
* Coordinate with content, marketing, and rights teams to plan release calendars and campaign tie\-ins.
* Manage monetisation health across channels — YouTube Partner Program compliance, ad formats, and revenue optimisation.
* Oversee community management — comments, community posts, and audience engagement signals.
* Support live\-streaming operations for key premieres, launches, and events.



  





**Must\-Have Qualifications** 



* 5–8 years of experience in YouTube channel management, digital video operations, or OTT/media content operations — ideally managing high\-volume, multi\-channel YouTube portfolios.
* Deep working knowledge of YouTube Studio, Content ID, copyright claims management, and the YouTube Partner Program monetisation ecosystem.
* Strong grasp of YouTube's discovery mechanics — metadata, SEO, thumbnails, titles, and retention drivers — with a track record of measurable channel growth.
* Experience managing publishing and scheduling operations across multiple channels at volume.
* Comfortable using YouTube Analytics and BI tools to track performance and inform programming decisions.
* Comfortable working cross\-functionally with content, marketing, legal/rights, and tech teams.
* Uses AI tools to summarise data, draft documents, and explore process improvements — and knows how to verify and correct AI outputs.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience with copyright dispute resolution or MCN\-style multi\-channel network operations.
* Familiarity with live\-streaming setup and management on YouTube.
* Experience running paid YouTube promotion or Google Ads campaigns.
* Comfort with SQL or similar tools for cross\-channel analytics and reporting.
* Familiarity with the Bengali entertainment and OTT content landscape.

description:
**Content \& Social Lead** 




 Location: Mumbai (on site)
 



 Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 4–6 years in content and social
 



  





 About NapChief:
 




 NapChief is a fast\-growing D2C kidswear brand. We sell through our own website (napchief.com) and all major marketplaces including Myntra, FirstCry, and Amazon. At Nap Chief, we're redefining kids' wear for a new generation of parents. We craft premium, super\-soft clothing that kids love to wear and parents trust.Our mission is to empower the young generation and we are looking for you to join forces with us to conquer this mission.
 




  





 About the role
 



 You will own NapChief’s entire content and social function everything the brand publishes, the calendar it runs on, the team that produces it, and the audience response it earns.This is a management seat first and a craft seat second. Five people report to you, and you will be measured by what your team produces, not by what you produce personally. If your ambition is to be the best maker in the room, this is the wrong role. If your ambition is to build a content engine that runs on a calendar and hits its dates without you in the middle of every task, this is the right one.
 



  





 Responsibilities:
 



**Content calendar and planning** 



* Own the rolling content calendar across Instagram, YouTube Shorts, and any platform we operate on — planned monthly, locked weekly, visible to the company in Asana with fixed start and end dates.
* Build the calendar around kidswear seasonality: the winter peak, festive and gifting windows, back\-to\-school, new collection drops, and end\-of\-season sale periods.
* Own the format mix — reels, statics, carousels, long\-form, UGC and rebalance it monthly against performance data rather than team preference.
* Plan against the two audiences that matter and be explicit about which one each piece addresses: parents, who buy, and children, who wear.



  





**Production and shoot management** 



* Own the shoot calendar end to end: concept, script, model casting and confirmation, location, props, styling, call sheets, and post\-production timelines.
* Hold the production schedule. A shoot that loses its models on the morning of is a planning failure build the confirmations, buffers, and fallbacks that prevent it.
* Manage external partners: photographers, videographers, editors, and studios, including rate negotiation and delivery timelines.
* Ensure every new collection has shoot\-ready assets before it goes live on the website and marketplaces.



  





**Organic social and community** 



* Own organic performance as a number: reach, engagement, saves, shares, follower growth, and non\-follower reach reported weekly against target, not anecdotally.
* Run publishing discipline. No reposting old content as filler. Retire formats once they stop performing and test new ones on a defined cadence.
* Own community management comments, DMs, and the response SLA routing anything that becomes a service issue to customer service.



  





**Influencer and UGC** 



* Own the influencer program through the influencer marketing owner on your team: partner selection, brief quality, deliverable tracking, usage rights, and cost per asset.
* Build a repeatable UGC pipeline from customers and parent creators, and route the best\-performing assets into the paid creative pool.
* Measure influencer spend the way we measure everything else — cost per usable asset, engagement earned, and contribution to sales where trackable.



  





**Brand storytelling** 



* Own the brand narrative in content: what NapChief stands for, how it sounds, and how that holds together across every post, campaign, and collection launch.
* Write and approve scripts and copy, or direct the team that does.
* Maintain the Master Creative Document as a living reference that survives any individual leaving.
* Run seasonal campaign concepts end to end: brief, narrative, asset list, timeline, and post\-campaign review against results.



  





**Team leadership** 



* Manage five people directly. Run weekly 1:1s and a documented weekly team review.
* Set priorities explicitly. Every person on your team should be able to state their top three priorities for the week without asking you.
* Hold people to dates. Where work slips you handle it directly — the conversation, the written expectation, the follow\-up, and the escalation if it repeats. Repeated following\-up is not management.
* Develop the team. Two of the five are in their first or second year. Your job is to make them independent, not to absorb their work when they struggle.
* Own hiring input, interview scorecards, and probation recommendations for your team.



  





**Coordination** 



* Work alongside the Brand Strategist, who owns creative for paid media. Your organic and production engine feeds that pipeline.
* One team member is coached by the Brand Strategist on creative craft while reporting to you — you own their priorities, performance, and review.
* Work with the Shopify and marketplace owners so launches, sale events, and campaigns have assets on time.



  





**KPIs you own** 



* Organic reach and engagement growth vs monthly target, including non\-follower reach
* Content calendar adherence — planned vs published, on date
* Shoot\-to\-live turnaround — days from shoot to assets available for use
* Asset throughput per month at the agreed quality bar
* Influencer cost per usable asset
* Team scorecard completion every person on your team on a live weekly scorecard



  





**Requirements:** 



* 4–6 years in content and social for consumer brands, including 2\+ years managing a team of four or more. Agency backgrounds are welcome, particularly if you ran a pod across brands and now want to go deep on one.
* Demonstrated people management with a mechanism behind it. You will be asked in the interview to walk through, week by week, how you handled someone who repeatedly missed deadlines. We are looking for a specific method, not persistence.
* Experience running a production calendar with real deadlines and real consequences — shoots, launches, and campaign dates that could not move.
* Strong planning and timeline management. This is the core competency for this seat, ahead of design or editing skill.
* Storytelling ability. You can articulate why a piece of content exists and what it should make a parent feel or do.
* Comfort with numbers: platform analytics, weekly reporting, and making format decisions from data.
* Hands\-on enough to be credible. You can brief, review, and give sharp feedback on a reel or a script even if you are not the one editing it.
* Working proficiency with Asana or an equivalent, plus social scheduling and analytics tooling.
* Not a fit if: your strongest asset is your personal portfolio and you would rather be making content than running a team; your management experience is limited to freelancers; or you have led social at a large brand where an agency and a producer handled production.

title: NSE 7 Fortinet Engineer / Architect
description:
About Interspence Solutions
 



 Established in August 2017,
 **Interspence Solutions LLP** 
 is a dynamic IT consulting and support services organization focused on delivering high\-value technology solutions across manufacturing and process industries. We are committed to fostering innovation, excellence, and continuous growth by building teams that drive business transformation through technology.
 



  





**Job Title:** 
 NSE 7 Fortinet Engineer / Architect
 



**Experience:** 
 6 \- 10 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Work from Home
 



  





 Position Summary
 



 We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled
 **Senior Network Security Engineer** 
 with strong expertise in
 **Fortinet Security Solutions** 
 to join our growing Cyber Security team.
 



 The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and supporting enterprise\-grade network security infrastructure with a primary focus on
 **FortiGate Firewalls, SD\-WAN, VPN Technologies, and Security Operations** 
 . The role requires excellent troubleshooting capabilities, hands\-on experience with Fortinet Security Fabric components, and the ability to support large\-scale enterprise environments.
 



  





 Key ResponsibilitiesFortinet Security Administration
 


* Deploy, configure, and manage FortiGate Firewalls across enterprise environments.
* Administer and maintain FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer platforms.
* Configure and manage Security Policies, NAT, IPS, Application Control, Web Filtering, and Threat Protection services.
* Perform firewall upgrades, migrations, firmware updates, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Configure and support High Availability (HA) and clustering solutions.
* Troubleshoot complex network and security issues and perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA).



 SD\-WAN \& VPN Management
 


* Design, implement, and manage Fortinet SD\-WAN solutions.
* Configure and troubleshoot IPsec VPN, SSL VPN, and ADVPN deployments.
* Optimize WAN connectivity, application performance, and traffic steering policies.
* Implement secure remote access solutions and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) frameworks.



 Network Security Operations
 


* Monitor security events, alerts, and network performance metrics.
* Perform incident response, threat investigation, and security troubleshooting activities.
* Ensure compliance with security best practices, policies, and organizational standards.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, and Application teams to maintain a secure and resilient environment.



 Routing \& Switching
 


* Configure and troubleshoot dynamic routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
* Support enterprise LAN/WAN environments and network segmentation initiatives.
* Maintain and update technical documentation including HLDs, LLDs, SOPs, and operational procedures.



 Documentation \& Governance
 


* Prepare implementation plans, technical documentation, and operational runbooks.
* Maintain asset inventory, configuration records, and change management documentation.
* Support internal and external audits and compliance initiatives.



 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* 6–10 years of experience in Network Security Engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience with FortiGate Firewalls.
* Expertise in FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer administration.
* Hands\-on experience with Fortinet SD\-WAN deployments and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of VPN technologies including IPsec VPN, SSL VPN, and ADVPN.
* Experience with High Availability (HA) and clustering solutions.
* Knowledge of routing protocols including BGP and OSPF.
* Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.



 Preferred Technical Skills
 


* Experience with FortiAuthenticator, FortiSwitch, and Fortinet Security Fabric solutions.
* Exposure to Palo Alto, Check Point, Cisco ASA/FTD, or other enterprise security platforms.
* Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or other cloud security technologies.
* Familiarity with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), SASE, and cloud security architectures.
* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale security environments.



  





 Mandatory Certification
 


* **Fortinet NSE 7 / FCSS – Network Security**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Join our Regulatory Reporting team and play a key role in keeping payments reporting accurate, timely, and well\-controlled. You will work with partners across trading, compliance, operations, and technology to deliver regulatory submissions and support audits. This role is a strong fit if you are analytical, detail\-focused, and motivated to improve processes through automation and continuous improvement.  

  

As an Analyst in Payments Regulatory Reporting Operations, you will prepare and submit regulatory reports to multiple regulators, including the Reserve Bank of India and the Financial Intelligence Unit. You will perform reconciliations, produce internal management reporting, and support internal, statutory, and concurrent audits. You will partner with cross\-functional teams to maintain strong controls and drive process improvements. This role requires working knowledge of India regulatory reporting and related treasury reporting products.  

  

**Job responsibilities**

* Prepare regulatory reports end\-to\-end, including reconciliations and timely submissions to regulators.
* Produce and distribute internal management information reports to relevant stakeholders.
* Prepare risk\-based supervision data points and perform variance analysis.
* Monitor nostro reconciliation breaks daily and circulate ageing reports on outstanding items.
* Partner with technology teams to automate reporting processes and strengthen controls.
* Prepare regional key performance indicator reports and assess the impact of new business initiatives on regulatory reporting.
* Support internal, statutory, and concurrent audits by providing accurate data and resolving audit queries on time.
* Coordinate with operations, trade support, finance, compliance, and legal teams to support control management and issue resolution.
* Maintain procedures and documentation by reviewing and updating standard operating procedures.
* Follow best practices to prevent control breaches and escalate issues when required.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to identify issues and propose practical solutions.
* Automation mindset with interest in improving efficiency and strengthening controls.
* Strong ownership and judgement, with the ability to escalate issues appropriately.
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills across teams and stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Flexibility and willingness to take on new assignments in a changing environment.

title: Learning Engineer – Technical Training Content
description:
Company Description
   

  

 Adler \& Pfau India Private Limited is the Indian subsidiary of Germany\-based Adler \& Pfau GmbH. The company develops educational programmes, technologies and infrastructure for international skills development and responsible global workforce mobility.
   

  

 A key focus is the development of practical technical training and professional\-development programmes for skilled professionals and technical planners. These programmes cover areas such as photovoltaic and solar technology, heat pumps, air\-conditioning and building\-services engineering, as well as other technologies supporting the energy and heating transition.
   

  

 Through the Adler \& Pfau Academy, the company develops digital, blended and practice\-oriented training programmes for international target groups. These programmes take into account applicable technical standards, regulatory requirements and the needs of the relevant labour markets. The Wings49\.com platform complements these activities with solutions for skills development, workforce readiness and international workforce mobility.
   

  

 As an India\-based company belonging to a German corporate group, Adler \& Pfau India offers employees the opportunity to develop technical education programmes for the Indian and German markets and contribute to international projects at the intersection of engineering, vocational education and technology.
   

  

 Role Description
   

  

 Learning Engineer – Technical Training Content
   

  

 As a Learning Engineer for technical training content, you will be responsible for the technical design, development and maintenance of digital and blended\-learning programmes in the fields of energy technology, electrical engineering, building services and HVAC technology.
   

  

 You will primarily develop training programmes and learning materials in the following areas:
   

  

 \- Solar and photovoltaic technology for skilled professionals
   

 \- Planning and design of solar and photovoltaic systems
   

 \- Installation, commissioning and maintenance of photovoltaic systems
   

 \- Heat\-pump technology
   

 \- Heating, ventilation, air\-conditioning and refrigeration technology
   

 \- Energy\-efficient building\-services engineering
   

 \- Electrical energy\-storage systems and EV charging infrastructure
   

 \- Other technologies supporting the energy and heating transition
   

  

 You will research, structure and transform complex technical information into clear, practical and target\-group\-oriented learning content. This will include digital learning modules, technical presentations, work instructions, practical exercises, case studies, knowledge assessments and supporting training materials.
   

  

 You will work closely with technical subject\-matter experts, education partners, trade organisations, training institutes and instructional designers in Germany and India. Together, you will ensure that all learning content is technically accurate, pedagogically effective and aligned with the requirements of the respective target groups and labour markets.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

 \- Developing curricula, course structures and learning pathways
   

 \- Defining technical and practical learning objectives
   

 \- Creating and reviewing technical training content
   

 \- Translating technical standards, safety requirements and practical regulations into accessible learning materials
   

 \- Developing interactive e\-learning modules and microlearning units
   

 \- Creating technical drawings, diagrams, calculation examples and practical exercises
   

 \- Collaborating with external subject\-matter experts and training partners
   

 \- Implementing and maintaining content within a learning management system
   

 \- Testing, reviewing and continuously improving learning programmes
   

 \- Managing documentation, version control and quality assurance
   

 \- Supporting the development of classroom\-based, online and blended\-learning formats
   

  

 This is a full\-time position based in Mumbai under a hybrid working model, with the option to perform part of the work remotely.
   

  

 Qualifications
   

  

 Academic Background
   

  

 You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in one of the following or a comparable field:
   

  

 \- Electrical Engineering
   

 \- Mechanical Engineering
   

 \- Energy Engineering
   

 \- Renewable Energy Engineering
   

 \- Building Services Engineering
   

 \- HVAC or Refrigeration Engineering
   

 \- Mechatronics
   

  

 Technical Knowledge
   

  

 You possess solid technical knowledge and, ideally, initial practical or academic experience in one or more of the following areas:
   

  

 \- Photovoltaic and solar technology
   

 \- Electrical installations and systems
   

 \- Heat pumps and thermal systems
   

 \- Heating, ventilation, air\-conditioning and refrigeration systems
   

 \- Energy efficiency and building\-services engineering
   

 \- Technical planning, installation or commissioning
   

  

 Technical Content Development
   

  

 You are able to analyse and structure complex technical subjects and present them clearly to skilled professionals, technicians and aspiring technical planners. Experience in creating technical documentation, training materials, presentations or digital learning content would be an advantage.
   

  

 E\-Learning and Learning Platforms
   

  

 Ideally, you have some experience with e\-learning authoring tools, learning management systems or SCORM\-based learning modules. However, this is not mandatory, as the necessary skills can be developed as part of the role. Strong technical understanding and the ability to quickly learn new digital tools are more important.
   

  

 Additional Skills
   

  

 \- Strong analytical and conceptual abilities
   

 \- Genuine interest in technical education and vocational training
   

 \- Ability to explain technical subjects clearly and practically
   

 \- Structured, accurate and independent working style
   

 \- Good written and spoken English
   

 \- Willingness to work with international teams
   

 \- Intercultural competence and strong teamwork skills
   

 \- Interest in renewable energy and sustainable technologies
   

  

 Recent graduates and early\-career professionals with a suitable technical degree are explicitly encouraged to apply. Previous experience in e\-learning development is advantageous but not required.
   

  

 Adler \& Pfau India is committed to equal opportunities and an inclusive working environment. Women and persons with disabilities are expressly encouraged to apply. All applications will be considered based on qualifications, skills and suitability for the position.
   

  

 Application Information:
   

 Please include the following information with your application:
   

 Your current annual salary (CTC)
   

 Your expected annual salary (CTC)
   

 Your contractual notice period
   

 Your earliest possible starting date
   

 Your current location and willingness to work a hybrid model in Mumbai

title: Zonal Head — Capital Formation and Investor Relations (East)
description:
***Zonal Head — Capital Formation and Investor Relations (East) \| Vantrock Investment Managers LLP \| Kolkata***




  





 Vantrock is India’s independent, operator\-led real assets platform — real assets only — with logistics and industrial as the first phase of its growth. This seat builds its distribution network in Kolkata and the East and owns the zone.
 



  





**Note:**
 team structure, reporting lines, direct reports, seat titles and hiring entity reflect the current plan and may change as the platform builds out. Compensation is confirmed in the offer.
 



  





**THE SEAT**




**Employer:**
 Vantrock Investment Managers LLP — the investment manager within Vantrock Ventures (the Vantrock Group)
 



**Reports to:**
 Head — Capital Formation and Investor Relations; until that seat is filled, directly to the Founder \& CEO, who will build the franchise with the zonal team hands\-on
 



**Direct reports:**
 None at launch — a senior single\-contributor seat with a very large number attached
 



**Location:**
 Kolkata, in office; twelve to fifteen travel days a month across Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi, Raipur
 



**Experience:**
 10–16 years
 



  





**ABOUT VANTROCK**




 Vantrock is an independent real assets platform. Real assets only. We start where we know the ground: logistics, warehousing and industrial parks, across the full chain — first mile, last mile, city\-centre, dark\-store and self\-storage formats, and logistics\-anchored mixed\-use developments with distribution below and office above. From there, in sequence and only as each is delivered: industrial plots; suburban campuses, GCC and back\-office space — vertical industries, where our expertise transfers; strata offices; and, in parallel, data centres and senior living.
 



  





 Three parts, kept separate. The founder’s balance sheet takes the first risk: land is acquired, de\-risked and approved on his capital before any investor commits. Vantrock Real Assets Private Limited — own board, team and governance — is the development manager and operator. Vantrock Investment Managers LLP, part of Vantrock Ventures, is the investment manager; its team underwrites every asset independently and answers to an independent Investment Committee — the operator and the manager kept at arm’s length by design.
 



  





 Alignment is structural: assets enter at cost, with no founder premium; the development team takes no fee and no profit on development management; the platform earns only after its investors have, through its share of additional returns.
 



  





 Founded by Anshul Singhal, Founder \& CEO — three institutional platforms built from zero, the fourth now on his own capital: 52 million sq ft delivered (32 million as developer, 20 million as contractor), 2,000\+ acres acquired, all litigation\-free, 200\+ buildings, two SEBI Category II funds run to a successful close — ₹2,775 Cr from roughly 1,000 investors through the distribution channel — India’s first domestic warehousing AIF, and India’s largest industrial real estate exit. Delivered across the founder’s three prior platforms. We hire number twos who want to become number one.
 



  





**THE FIRST STRATEGY**




 Six product lines — industrial parks, warehousing, suburban office, starter office, first\-mile and last\-mile logistics — through a seeded AIF alongside deal\-by\-deal co\-investment via CIV and co\-investment PMS routes. Seeded means the operator puts assets in place before the fund launches, so 50–60% of the pipeline is typically identified and de\-risked on day one. No blind\-pool vehicle is ever raised. Two sales in one: a fund commitment, and larger co\-investment tickets.
 



  





**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**




 Own the zone. Build the distribution and IFA network in East and North\-East India — Kolkata, Guwahati, Bhubaneswar, Patna, Ranchi and Raipur, activate the RMs and advisers inside it, and convert it into committed capital for the first strategy — and a channel ready for the next.
 



  





 Not a cold start. The platform brings an existing investor base, sponsor and anchor commitments in place, and a founder known in the AIF and product channel from two prior funds; you will be welcomed. What does not yet exist is the franchise — the empanelments, the certified RMs, the joint calls — and there is no team to delegate it to in Year 1\. Seniority here means credibility and judgment, not a desk.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL OWN**




 – The network: national distributors’ regional offices, regional distributors, IFAs/MFDs, DSAs, RIAs, multi\-family offices and wealth\-platform regional desks — 5–7 firms empanelled and live.
 



 – The full empanelment cycle, locally — first meeting to product committee to go\-live — for both the fund and the co\-investment routes.
 



 – Activation: branch meetings, huddles and desk conversations until 35–50 RMs and IFAs in the zone have each placed at least one ticket.
 



 – Conversion: joint client meetings as the core of the job; the pipeline from interest through contribution agreement to funds received.
 



 – The map: every relevant RM, IFA and product head in the zone, in the CRM, weekly.
 



 – Investor relations in the zone after the close, with Fund Operations: drawdowns, reporting queries, site visits, and the hard conversation when something goes wrong.
 



 – The face of Vantrock in Kolkata and the East, and the first call a partner makes when a client asks a hard question.
 



  





**THIS IS A FRONT\-FACING SEAT**




 You do not sell to the distributors and stop; you sell with them. Accompany partners and their RMs to clients and pitch the fund yourself. Tell the story — operator\-led, seeded pipeline, the asset class — so an RM can repeat it under pressure. Host investor evenings, partner meets and site visits in Kolkata and the East, and speak at them — and at trade shows, expos and industry forums. Be present on LinkedIn as a named voice of the platform. Approved material only; no return promises, ever.
 



  





**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**




**Essential**




 – 10–16 years in financial services, at least five in B2B or B2B2C distribution of PMS, AIF or mutual\-fund products from the manufacturer’s side — an AMC, alternatives manager or fund house. You have carried a distribution number and been paid against it.
 



 – Verifiable relationships with distributor product heads, national and regional distributors and the top IFA/MFD firms in East and North\-East India — you can name them, and they take your call.
 



 – You have launched a product into the channel from scratch at least once — not only carried an established brand.
 



 – Third\-party capital raised through the channel, stated as capital drawn, not “assets influenced”.
 



 – Graduate; MBA, PGDM, CA or CFA or equivalent; NISM as applicable.
 



 – Appetite for the road: twelve to fifteen travel days a month is the job, not an exception to it.
 



 Advantageous
 



 – Real\-assets fund background (not mandatory — a strong alternatives channel salesperson from equity, credit or PMS is often the superior hire); an AMC alternates or PMS desk; co\-investment tickets sold alongside a fund. Standing in the Marwari, Bengali and North\-East business communities, where alternatives penetration is low relative to wealth.
 



 What this role is not
 



 A B2B distribution seat, not a private\-wealth seat. If your career has been advising your own HNI clients, or selling directly to institutions, this is the wrong role. The job is to persuade another firm’s RMs and IFAs to sell Vantrock — and make them successful when they do.
 



  





**COMPENSATION AND WEALTH CREATION**




 Upper\-quartile benchmark, deliberately weighted from take\-home to wealth creation. Four parts, a mix of all four: fixed; a capital\-formation incentive on the capital you personally bring in, plus a team component on the platform’s total raise; a share in the platform’s additional returns on strategies you help close; and ESOPs. We want the next generation of capital\-formation talent — people who would rather build long\-term wealth with a platform they helped create than optimise a salary. Numbers in the first conversation.
 



  





**VANTROCK CULTURAL FIT**




 We’re building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We’re looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co\-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying “I don’t know” and “I was wrong.” If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn’t the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.
 



  





 AI\-native by construction: the group’s first company was Vantrock Intelligence, and everyone here works with AI daily, with the judgment to check it — fluent AI use is tested at interview for every hire. A place to belong: a small team of co\-builders with real ownership; nobody is a seat on an org chart.
 



  





**HOW WE WILL ASSESS**




 1\. A fixed set of questions, on video (preferred) or in writing — an automated email with an AI\-interview link follows your application; about forty minutes, reviewed before the CV.
 



 2\. The Vantrock AI Proficiency Test, sent in the same email.
 



 3\. A network conversation — who in Kolkata and the East you would call in your first ninety days — then the Founder \& CEO.
 



 4\. References: two contacted directly, at least one a distributor product head.
 



 Once we have your application, interview and test, we reach out with next steps. Your application is confidential — seen only by the Founder’s Office and the hiring lead.
 



  





**TO APPLY**




***Email careers@vantrock.com, subject: Zonal Head — Capital Formation and Investor Relations (East) — \[your name]. Include your CV or profile link, the products you have launched into the channel in this zone, your notice period and expectation, and one short paragraph: the first three distributors in Kolkata and the East you would take a new real\-assets strategy to, and why. That paragraph matters more than the CV.***




  





***We don’t hire roles. We build the platform. Ownership, not employment. Builders hire builders.
 
 ﻿***

title: Associate Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
The Associate \- Accounts Receivable is responsible for the Order\-to\-Cash activities of its Business Lines covering billing, collections, cash application, and revenue recognition and reporting — ensuring accuracy, timely recovery of receivables, and clear visibility of customer outstanding balances for the business.
   

  

 The role brings standardisation to customer\-level visibility of revenue, invoicing and outstanding balances, and holds ownership of collections performance for an assigned customer portfolio, including ageing, DSO and overdue exposure. It requires a sound understanding of the business and its revenue drivers, the ability to manage large data sets and present up\-to\-date insights, control over pricing in the revenue systems, and effective partnering with Sales and Account Management on outstanding invoices, billing queries and customer escalations.
   

  

**Requirements**
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
   

  

* Maintain up\-to\-date, detailed pricing data to support invoicing and revenue management
* Apply control checks on invoicing data across all revenue streams
* Participate in the end\-to\-end Accounts Receivable process, from invoice generation through to collection and cash application
* Prepare, review and issue customer invoices accurately and on schedule, ensuring supporting data, tariffs and contractual terms are correctly applied before dispatch, and resolving discrepancies prior to release
* Manage collections for an assigned customer portfolio: monitor ageing reports, follow up on overdue invoices through structured dunning, and escalate long\-outstanding or high\-risk accounts in line with the agreed escalation matrix
* Issue statements of account and payment reminders, and record committed payment dates and collection notes to maintain a reliable receivables and cash\-inflow forecast
* Perform cash application on a daily basis, allocating incoming receipts to the correct customer invoices and matching remittance advices accurately
* Interact with Sales and Account Management on outstanding invoices — sharing overdue positions, obtaining customer feedback, resolving billing queries and disputes, and jointly agreeing recovery actions on ageing accounts
* Coordinate and assist in year\-end finalisation and audits, providing AR schedules and supporting documentation


**Requirements**
 Minimum Education/Qualification: Bachelor of Commerce (CMA, CA, B. Com or BBA); accounting certifications an advantage.
   

  

 Min. Experience :
   

  

* 4\+ years' experience in accounts receivable, billing or order\-to\-cash
* Direct communication with customers on billing and collections matters


 Industry
   

  

* 
* Order\-to\-cash, billing, collections or revenue accounting environment
* 
* Maritime technology, shipping services or a transaction\-based business preferred


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Hands\-on experience across the end\-to\-end order\-to\-cash cycle: billing, collections and cash application
* ERP experience (NetSuite or equivalent), including the AR and billing modules
* Maintenance of pricing and tariff data in revenue systems, including approval controls
* Control over credit notes and amendments to issued invoices
* Cash application, remittance matching and clearing of unapplied, unidentified or short\-paid receipts
* Statements of account, structured dunning and escalation processes
* Revenue reconciliation between invoicing and operational data
* Monthly revenue reporting, budget deviation analysis and forecasting models
* Analytics and data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI) for AR, billing and revenue reporting
* Advanced Excel, with the ability to manage and interpret large data sets

title: Programme Director – EAP & Employee Wellbeing
description:
**Position Summary** 




 The Programme Director is the single point of accountability for Truworth Wellness's EAP engagement with SBI. Deployed at the Bank's Corporate Centre, this role serves as the senior escalation point for the account, the primary interface with SBI's HR Department, and the owner of programme governance, stakeholder alignment, and strategic oversight across the full lifecycle of the engagement — from implementation through steady\-state delivery, contract renewal, and eventual transition\-out. The Programme Director is directly accountable to the Bank for SLA adherence, governance discipline, and the quarterly performance outcomes on which contract payments are conditioned.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Client Governance \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the Bank's senior escalation point and primary accountability owner for all aspects of the EAP engagement.
* Serve as the primary interface between Truworth Wellness and SBI's HR Department on programme governance, stakeholder alignment, and strategic direction.
* Chair/lead the Programme Steering Committee and monthly Operational Review Meetings with the Bank's designated Programme Manager and other stakeholders.
* Ensure Minutes of Meeting are circulated within 5 working days of each governance forum, and own the consolidated action tracker through to closure.
* Represent the programme in leadership\-level reviews, audits, and any ad hoc governance requirements raised by the Bank.



**Service Delivery \& SLA Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the scope of work: 24×7 counselling and crisis intervention, wellbeing programmes, the Holistic Health Champion Programme, webinars, and awareness campaigns.
* Monitor SLA and KPI performance continuously; drive corrective action on any shortfall to avoid penalties or liquidated damages, and to secure release of quarterly performance\-linked payments.
* Oversee the implementation and onboarding plan in Year 1 (platform configuration, HRMS/SSO integration, counsellor mobilisation, launch sessions) and, at contract end, the transition\-out plan, knowledge transfer, and data wipe\-out certification.
* Ensure continuity of care for employees under active counselling in the event of any transition to a successor provider.



**Reporting, Analytics \& Compliance** 



* Ensure timely submission of monthly, quarterly, and annual programme reports, and the quarterly performance certificate required for payment release.
* Own the accuracy and governance of the centralised analytics dashboard, including weekly data refresh and segmentation across Bank\-defined dimensions.
* Ensure the programme's data privacy and confidentiality practices comply with the DPDP Act 2023, the Bank's information\-security requirements, and Truworth's ISO 27001 obligations.
* Oversee the annual wellbeing survey and impact assessment, and present aggregated, de\-identified findings and improvement roadmaps at Circle, AO, and organisational levels.



**Team \& Account Leadership** 



* Lead and performance\-manage the dedicated Account Management team, technical/platform manager, and coordination with the clinical/counselling panel supporting SBI.
* Own resourcing and continuity for the account, including managing any key\-personnel changes through the Bank's prior\-notification and approval process.
* Build internal readiness for scale — pan\-India service delivery, multilingual counselling, and nationwide referral network coordination.



**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Minimum 10 years of experience in EAP/ employee wellbeing,/behavioural health, or related domains.
* Proven experience managing large, enterprise\-scale accounts, ideally with PSU, banking, or BFSI\-sector clients, including exposure to formal vendor governance frameworks.
* Postgraduate qualification in Psychology, Human Resources, Business/Public Health Management, or a related field is preferred.
* Working knowledge of SLA\-based managed\-services contracts, data privacy regulation (DPDP Act 2023\), and information\-security frameworks such as ISO 27001\.
* Demonstrated ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders (DGM level and above) and to run structured governance forums.
* Strong command of programme reporting, dashboards, and outcome\-based/KPI\-linked performance management.



**Key Competencies** 



* Executive stakeholder management and senior\-level relationship building.
* Programme and vendor governance discipline — meeting cadence, documentation, action tracking.
* Commercial acumen — understanding of SLA/KPI\-linked, performance\-based payment structures.
* Crisis\-management orientation and sound judgement on escalations.
* Data\-driven decision\-making, with comfort reading and presenting utilisation and outcome analytics.
* High personal discretion and commitment to confidentiality and data privacy.



**Key Performance Indicators** 



* SLA and KPI compliance across all quarterly delivery cycles.
* Successful, on\-schedule conduct of Programme Steering Committee and Operational Review Meetings.
* Timeliness and quality of monthly, quarterly, and annual reports and dashboards.
* Employee utilisation, engagement, and satisfaction trends against annual targets.
* Zero material findings on data privacy, confidentiality, or ISO 27001 compliance.
* Achievement of quarterly performance certification required for release of contract payment.

 As a Quality Professional, you will play a crucial role in driving quality excellence across Siemens Energy's High Voltage, Digital Grid, FACTS, HVDC, and Project businesses. You will act as a trusted quality advisor to management and cross\-functional teams, ensuring that quality management systems, processes, and compliance frameworks are effectively implemented and continuously improved.
